newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HUNTER DOUGLAS JAN-SEPT SALES UP 8.9 PCT.
newsitem.headline: HUNTER DOUGLAS JAN-SEPT SALES UP 8.9 PCT.

text.p: Hunter Douglas NV said on Tuesday it had achieved sales of 1.66 billion guilders in the January-September period of 1996, compared with 1.53 billion in the year-ago period.
The 8.9 percent increase in turnover was the result of a 5.9 percent growth in volume and a 3.0 percent gain from exchange rate differences, the firm said.
The window blinds maker and aluminium trader said in August it was optimistic about prospects in the second half of 1996 after reporting a 24.8 percent profit rise for the first half.
Net profit was 62.9 million guilders in the first half of 1996.
"The company's overall profitability continues to be strong and confirms the optimistic outlook for the full-year," it said.
Hunter Douglas' said sales in North America and Asia increased sharply.
Latin America operations also increased sales.

Sales in Europe were lower due mainly to slow consumer demand and building activity in Germany and France, partly offset by higher sales in the United Kingdon and in Eastern Europe. Sales in Australia were slightly lower, it said.
